verdict.rationale: Caveman ships a skill and an agent workspace that supports plugins, so a browsable skills catalog is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence never mentions a registry, leaderboard, marketplace, or any way to search available skills before installing. The line "Plugins from Claude Code, Codex and Cursor" shows plugin compatibility, which is an adjacent feature, not a discovery catalog.

support.subject: As a developer, I can browse or search a catalog of available skills — a registry, leaderboard, or marketplace listing — before installing anything
